title: Huge response to SCL statement: at least we all care about libraries
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: There was a pretty much unprecedented response, in terms of blog reads and comments, to the President of the Society of Chief Librarians’ post on the previous edition of Public Libraries News. Some, not all, of the responses can best be characterised as extremely opposed, although I personally understood the SCL position a bit better at the end of it, even if I wish they’d start putting their head at least a little above the parapet. I don’t want to enter the fray too much again here, perhaps I have done too much to stoke the fires as it is, but would recommend you read the comments on the previous post if you want to understand it all. For me, I can at least take comfort that all sides genuinely and deeply care for the service and with the fervent hope that numerous chief librarians and library staff will jolly well get on the board with the #MyLibraryByRight campaign anyway. And also that everyone involved will sign the petition for goodness sake, and get people you know to sign it as well.
